findings.value: A record shop selling vinyl in Mare Street Market, Hackney. Its events have included listening parties, release parties and signings.

evidence.quote: Jon Hassell 'Music Is Invisible' Listening Party

findings.value: The shop's events listing has included record release parties with DJs, listening parties and artist signings.

notes: Source: the shop's own home page only (its events and genre menus; the about page returned 404). Its genre menu (rock, jazz, electronic and others) describes stock rather than a night, so no music.styles finding is proposed. No press review found: WebSearch budget was used up before this run's searches. The events shown are single listings, so the music note describes kinds of event, not a regular night.
